items.name: LEAD-001
items.reason: Existing LEAD-001 is extended additively with deterministic scoring/contact-confidence logic. No parallel lead engine, PROD execution, CRM write or outreach authority is introduced.

items.name: fit_score
items.reason: Deterministically reuses evidenced ICP scoring from the existing Lead Discovery profile, bounded to 0-100 and not independently activated in PROD.

items.name: intent_score
items.reason: Deterministically reuses Company Intent and First-Party page-intent outputs; no duplicate intent engine is created and no PROD activation is claimed.

items.name: urgency_score
items.reason: Freshness-weighted explicit business-event urgency scoring is implemented with personal/protected attributes excluded and remains PREPROD only.

items.name: conversion_probability
items.reason: A deterministic heuristic V0 exists for prioritization, explicitly not statistically calibrated and not a deployed ML model. It requires future real-outcome calibration before stronger autonomy claims.

items.name: expected_value
items.reason: Bounded analytical probability × business-value calculation is implemented for prioritization only and carries no authority to move money or mutate prices.

items.name: next_best_action
items.reason: Plan-only prioritization/research/review action exists; outreach execution and CRM mutation remain disabled until later channel/permission gates.

items.name: Verifio
items.reason: Upstream license evidence conflicts: README labels the project MIT while LICENSE includes Apache-2.0 wording plus additional commercial/hosting restrictions. No code, image, SDK or dependency is used until a future legal/license gate resolves this.

items.name: email/MX/SMTP/catch-all confidence
items.reason: Local passive syntax/domain/MX and authorized pre-existing SMTP evidence scoring exists. Active SMTP probing, email sending and false certainty about catch-all domains remain disabled.

items.name: phone/contact confidence
items.reason: Lawful-source normalization and structural plausibility scoring exist without carrier/person lookup or a paid verification service.
